What’s New This Month on this Page (November 2026)




✔ Alberta records 388,585 active player accounts in September. AiGC’s first market report counts accounts used during the month, rather than unique people, since players may have accounts with multiple operators.
Albertans Choosing Safe, Regulated iGaming

✔ Casino games lead Alberta’s early market results. In September, casino games accounted for 75.6% of reported non-adjusted gross gaming revenue, with live casino contributing another 4.9%. Sports and event betting represented the remaining 19.5%.
Albertans Choosing Safe, Regulated iGaming

✔ Atlantic Lottery retires several casino games. Eight progressive jackpot titles, including Wild Wild 7s and Money Frog, were removed from alc.ca on October 7. Atlantic Lottery said remaining progressive jackpot funds would transfer to Cash Machine Jackpots.
Atlantic Lottery Removes Eight Progressive Jackpot Games From ALC.ca

✔ Ontario’s online gambling revenue rises 5% in September. iGaming Ontario reported C$416.3 million in non-adjusted gross gaming revenue, up from C$396.3 million in August. Active player accounts also increased to approximately 1.41 million, although these do not represent unique players. iGaming Ontario’s Market Performance Report

 

Canadian Casino News: November 2026




✔ Alberta releases its first regulated iGaming results. Published October 23, the report recorded C$56.6 million in non-adjusted gross gaming revenue for September, compared with C$43.3 million in August. AiGC cautioned that operators were still joining during the reporting period, so the figures do not represent a fully onboarded market.
Albertans Choosing Safe, Regulated iGaming

✔ AGCO issues C$200,000 penalty over misleading cash-out offers. In an October 6 announcement, Ontario’s regulator said theScore.Bet presented a player with two cash-out offers that were not honoured. The AGCO found the offers were not achievable as presented and breached Ontario’s player protection standards.
AGCO issues $200,000 penalty to theScore.Bet over misleading cash-out offers

✔ Ontario casino communities receive C$34.5 million. OLG announced October 21 that 29 communities hosting land-based casinos would receive payments totalling C$34,505,783 for July through September. This brought payments for the first half of its fiscal year to approximately C$76.9 million. Olg Issues Second Quarter Gaming Revenue Payments To Municipal Partners

✔ OLG’s Daily Drop promotion runs through November. The promotion began October 5 and is scheduled to end November 30. Eligible Ontario players aged 19+ can participate once daily for a chance to receive casino bonuses, subject to a 1x wagering requirement and seven-day expiry.
OLG Daily Drop

Editor’s Picks: Games of the Month
Gates of Olympus

Pragmatic Play’s Gates of Olympus is a video slot that was released in 2021 and is widely available at the best casinos in Canada. It is a game of multiplier chaos, featuring Pragmatic’s famous Tumble Reels feature for cascading wins.

It has a 6x5 grid with the scatter pay system for wins to form anywhere on the reels. A random multiplier makes each spin dynamic, with Zeus throwing multipliers ranging from 2x to 500x onto the reels. There is also a free spins bonus where the multipliers can accumulate for bigger payouts. Gates of Olympus is a Greek-themed game with plenty of high volatility thrills.

Vikings Go Berzerk

Yggdrasil’s video slot, Vikings Go Berzerk, brings a unique strategic edge to its gameplay. You can play this slot at many of our best online casinos for Canadians and enjoy the storytelling aspect of the game.

There is a Rage feature mechanic that fills up as you spin the reels and can open a free spins bonus when it fills up. This bonus round is innovative because it is a battle against sea monsters, where you can get sticky wilds. Other features include treasure chests and random multipliers.

Razor Shark

Push Gaming’s Razor Shark is a high volatility slot game that is jam-packed with features. One of them is the game-defining Seaweed feature that lands onto the reels with wilds, Gold Sharks, and bonus symbols.
